sql:
SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  fish_date_t,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as num_boats,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / SUM(anglers), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips 
WHERE fish_date_t >= 145 AND fish_date_t <= 152
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, fish_date_t, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_t, cls
